lines.t: Use: Unrolls a banner that allows you and other members of the Horde sitting nearby to gain [(60 < 40 ? 14 : (60 < 50 ? 19 : (60 < 60 ? 27 : 32)))] increased Spirit, mutually exclusive with Divine Spirit.
Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)

Use: Unrolls a banner that allows you and other members of the Alliance sitting nearby to gain [(60 < 40 ? 14 : (60 < 50 ? 19 : (60 < 60 ? 27 : 32)))] increased Spirit, mutually exclusive with Divine Spirit.

Use: Places a Spinning Wheel that allows the creation of certain reagents, and provides all the benefits of a Faction Banner. Requires a Campfire nearby.
May be placed over a Faction Banner to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)
Use: Places a Loom usable for recipes that require it, and provides all the benefits of a Faction Banner. Requires a Campfire nearby.
May be placed over a Faction Banner to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown)
